requirement: Claude sign-in is `kogen provider login claude-code`, and the page says it "installs Kogen's own Claude Code and opens its sign-in"
finding_message: Unmet requirement: "Claude sign-in is `kogen provider login claude-code`, and the page says it \"installs Kogen's own Claude Code and opens its sign-in\"". docs/getting-started.md at Kogen main (lines 41 and 47) says `kogen provider login claude-code` takes a "Claude Code token from claude setup-token", read from standard input. It does not say the command opens a sign-in. The page sentence, which the protected acceptance requires word for word, therefore states something the release docs contradict. The acceptance also forbids `setup-token` on the page, so the page cannot match the docs here. This is a contradiction between the protected acceptance and Kogen main, and the Intent says to report it instead of editing around it.
